tagline: Leading independent petroleum refiner and renewable fuels producer
hero_kpi_rationale: Refining segment margins reflect Valero's core operational performance in processing crude oil and are a key indicator of cyclical profitability in the refining sector

kpis.name: Refining Segment Margins
kpis.explanation: Gross margin of the refining segment (gasoline and distillates)
kpis.description: Gross margin of the refining segment including gasoline and distillates margins

kpis.name: Renewable Diesel Segment Margins
kpis.explanation: Gross margin of the renewable diesel segment
kpis.description: Gross margin of the renewable diesel and low-carbon fuels segment

risks.title: Commodity Price Risk
risks.score_rationale: Valero is heavily exposed to volatility in crude oil, refined product prices, and feedstock costs. This directly impacts refining and renewable diesel segment margins, which are core to the business model.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risk
risks.score_rationale: Valero faces increasing regulatory requirements for renewable fuel standards (RFS), low-carbon fuel programs, environmental standards, and GHG emissions regulations across multiple jurisdictions.

risks.title: Interest Rate and Financing Risk
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate fluctuations affect the cost of borrowing for capital investments and operations, but Valero generates substantial cash flow that mitigates this risk.

risks.title: Asset Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: Recent asset impairment charges at Benicia and Wilmington refineries highlight the risk of stranded assets if market fundamentals deteriorate or transition risks accelerate.

risks.title: Geopolitical and Supply Chain Risk
risks.score_rationale: Global conflicts affect crude oil supply and pricing. Trade restrictions and sanctions can impact feedstock availability and market access.

ai_positioning.summary: Valero Energy Corporation does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing for fiscal year 2025.
